# `csharp_preserve_single_line_statements`

Allow a control-flow body the author left on its header's line to stay there.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Clamp(int n)
    {
        if (n < 0) return 0;
        if (n > 100) return 100;
        return n;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Clamp(int n)
    {
        if (n < 0)
            return 0;
        if (n > 100)
            return 100;
        return n;
    }
}
```
:::

::::

*Setting shown: `csharp_preserve_single_line_statements = false`*

### `csharp_preserve_single_line_statements = true`

```ini
csharp_preserve_single_line_statements = true
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Clamp(int n)
    {
        if (n < 0) return 0;
        if (n > 100) return 100;
        return n;
    }
}
```
